title: Core: Brush tool stroke builder
description: Implement a brush tool stroke builder in packages/core/src/engine/brushtool.ts. Function: addBrushStroke(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, points: Array<{x,y,pressure}>, strokeColor, strokeWidth): FlashDocument. Converts the points array to a smoothed ShapePath with filled paths (brush strokes are filled shapes, not stroked lines in Flash). Use Catmull-Rom spline smoothing and create a closed path outlining the stroke width. Add unit tests.
